summary: Polyrizon Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a $4.0 million registered direct offering and concurrent private placement with a single institutional investor. The company issued 333,333 units (or pre-funded units) at $12.00 per unit, consisting of ordinary shares, pre-funded warrants, and common warrants with a $12.00 exercise price. Gross proceeds were approximately $4.0 million. Aegis Capital Corp. acted as exclusive placement agent. Net proceeds will fund general corporate purposes and working capital. This is a routine capital-raising under an existing shelf registration; no special-situation category applies.
